rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the Court unanimous with a narrow opinion emphasizing Article III standing limits and characterizing ICWA chiefly as preemptive federal rules of decision that state courts apply under the Supremacy Clause, with Mancari controlling equal-protection framing. Gorsuch (and possibly Thomas/Alito) is the most likely to write separately to elaborate federal Indian-law foundations or to flag residual anti-commandeering/nondelegation concerns while still joining the judgment.
